steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Engineering drawings communicate design intent precisely using standardised conventions and symbols. | Key Fact: Orthographic projection shows multiple 2D views: front elevation, plan and side elevation. | Key Fact: Third angle projection places views in the orientation seen from that direction (the UK standard). | Key Fact: Isometric drawing shows a 3D view at 30 degrees with no perspective distortion; all axes at true scale.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from engineering drawings &amp; cad/cam, and one past-paper question.
